description: This file contains test cases written using pytest and unittest.mock for testing the RedisClusterCache class from the litellm.caching.redis_cluster_cache module. It includes tests for batch_get_cache and async_batch_get_cache methods, verifying they use mget_nonatomic for batch retrievals and correctly mock Redis client behavior.

methods.name: test_redis_cluster_batch_get(mock_init_redis_cluster)
methods.description: Tests that RedisClusterCache.batch_get_cache uses mget_nonatomic instead of mget for batch operations.

methods.name: test_redis_cluster_async_batch_get(mock_init_redis_cluster)
methods.description: Tests that RedisClusterCache.async_batch_get_cache uses mget_nonatomic instead of mget for async batch operations.
